name: Async Audio-Reactive Lighting & Screen Ambilight
summary: Sub-30ms real-time Windows WASAPI loopback audio capture and real-time screen ambilight with dynamic FFT multi-band lighting dispatch to Tuya IoT devices, wrapped in a windowless Windows System Tray application.

solved_bugs.symptom: WASAPI audio input buffer underrun causing audio crackles during high CPU loads.
solved_bugs.root_cause: Sampling buffer inadequate when UI thread blocked the audio capture callback.
solved_bugs.solution_pattern: Use 1024-sample ring buffer with thread-safe lock-free dequeue and decouple audio loop from Tuya network calls.

solved_bugs.symptom: Tuya UDP packet flood causing bulb connection dropouts.
solved_bugs.root_cause: Sending raw 60 FPS RGB updates over saturated 2.4 GHz local Wi-Fi UDP sockets.
solved_bugs.solution_pattern: Throttle Tuya local LAN dispatch to 25-30 FPS with delta-threshold filtering (only send if HSV delta > 2%).

solved_bugs.symptom: System tray icon rendered as faint grey circle with a green dot and caused Windows 11 taskbar redraw glitches.
solved_bugs.root_cause: Periodic 100ms UI timer in app_tray.py continuously called tray_icon.setIcon(create_orb_icon()), overwriting the static brand logo on every tick and triggering frequent OS taskbar redraws.
solved_bugs.solution_pattern: Decouple static branding from dynamic painting: display official multi-resolution transparent brand icon as default with zero timer overhead; only invoke dynamic orb painter if user explicitly switches to 'Dynamic Live RGB Orb' via tray context menu.

solved_bugs.symptom: Startup launcher popped up a black terminal console window and required navigating deep directory trees.
solved_bugs.root_cause: Standard python.exe launches with a console subsystem window allocated by Windows.
solved_bugs.solution_pattern: Provide an Async.vbs WScript.Shell runner executing pythonw.exe with window style 0 (SW_HIDE) and redirect headless sys.stdout/sys.stderr to os.devnull.

solved_bugs.symptom: Raw square brand image with black outer canvas caused visual distortion and lack of transparency when scaled across taskbar and web dashboards.
solved_bugs.root_cause: Generated raster art had solid background canvas and non-standard dimensions instead of alpha-channel transparent squircle tiles.
solved_bugs.solution_pattern: Created standardized master asset suite: multi-resolution Windows icon (icon.ico from 16x16 to 256x256), antialiased squircle tiles, Android Chrome icons, Apple touch icons, and site.webmanifest with dynamic aiohttp route handlers.

solved_bugs.symptom: When switched to Solid Color -> White Palette, the physical bulb remained locked out from returning to Color Spectrum, Audio Sync, or Screen Ambilight, and audio output endpoints could not be switched from the control panel.
solved_bugs.root_cause: 1. Duplicate set_hsv method at the end of TuyaDriver class overwritten the implementation and bypassed current_mode and _mode_switched tracking. 2. Tuya 3.5 firmware dropped single bundled packets containing DP 21 ('colour') and DP 24 (HSV hex) simultaneously. 3. LightControlPanel lacked an interactive audio device switcher to trigger Windows WASAPI endpoint transitions.
solved_bugs.solution_pattern: 1. Removed duplicate set_hsv method in TuyaDriver. 2. Enforced reliable 2-step packet sequence for Tuya 3.5 mode switches (DP 20/21 set first, followed by DP 24 or DP 22/23 payload) and invalidated last_white/last_hsv delta caches. 3. Added interactive btn_audio_device dropdown pill with deviceSelected signal connected to AudioCapture.switch_device() in app_tray.py.

architectural_rules: Decouple audio sampling loop from Tuya UDP socket dispatch.
Strict local LAN control (sub-40ms latency, zero cloud dependency).
Always wrap sounddevice / pyaudiowpatch stream closures in finally blocks.
Run background services windowless via pythonw.exe or VBS launcher to prevent command prompt popups.
Never overwrite static system tray brand icon in periodic timers unless dynamic live orb mode is explicitly selected.
Enforce single-instance tray execution using QLocalServer/QLocalSocket ('Async20_Tray_App') to prevent duplicate background runners.
Serve static web assets (favicons, manifests, logos) dynamically via aiohttp route handlers from a centralized assets/ directory.
Dual White and Color Spectrum Control with Master Power Toggle
Three-Tier Studio Mode Architecture and Impeccable Hardware UI Deck
Tuya 3.5 Protocol: Always split mode switch DP 21 and payload DP 24 into two consecutive calls to prevent hardware firmware packet drops.
Invalidate hardware delta cache (last_white, last_hsv) immediately on mode transitions to guarantee initial frame transmission.
